title: HoloGen training materials
text:
Open online resource for training materials from the HoloGen MSCA Doctoral Network. Each retreat below lists its full programme of lectures and workshops. Slides are linked where the presenter has agreed to share them openly; sessions without a link have no slides published.
Retreat dates are listed on the events page.
